observations: UEC commenced production at Burke Hollow in April 2026 and is operating two of three U.S. hub-and-spoke ISR platforms.
Fiscal Q3 disclosure reported $794M of liquid assets including $488M cash and no debt, plus 1.456M lb U3O8 inventory at April 30.
Quarter production was 32,195 lb at $54.61 total cost/lb and $46.69 cash cost/lb; cumulative since commissioning was 276,516 lb at lower $39.30 total cost/lb.
Christensen Ranch added header houses, Burke Hollow ramped, and conversion-facility licensing/design work advanced.
risks: quarterly unit costs rose on low production and regulatory timing
uranium price exposure is deliberately unhedged
conversion facility remains pre-license/design and siting stage
contradictions: Strong liquidity and strategic inventory coexist with early-stage production volumes and quarter-specific cost inflation.
unknowns: sustainable steady-state production/cost at Burke Hollow
conversion facility site, license timing and capital requirement

recommendation.reason: Current operating and balance-sheet evidence is reusable for underwriting, while score construction remains Alpha authority.
